title: automation: tenant RBAC bootstrap for private-installer + Helm/Terraform modules
author: Asha Patel
description:
Motivation: Automate tenant RBAC bootstrapping for Private deployments (VPC/on-prem) so that installer and infra automation can reliably create the minimal roles and bindings required for tenant isolation and operator workflows. This PR wires together three pieces: Helm chart templates for the private-installer, a Terraform module for infra-level role bindings, and automation scripts used by the private-installer operator. The goal is to make tenant creation idempotent, auditable, and safe for upgrades without manual RBAC steps.

What this PR changes (high level):
- Adds Helm templates under charts/private-installer for tenant-scoped Roles, RoleBindings, and ClusterRole/ClusterRoleBinding bootstraps with configurable scopes and annotations. Templates are parameterized to support both single-tenant and multi-tenant modes.
- Introduces a modules/tenant-rbac Terraform module that can be used by infra provisioning to pre-create cloud IAM-to-K8S mappings and to seed initial RBAC objects when customers opt for managed bootstrap. Module includes documented inputs for principal mapping and audit labels.
- Adds automation/tenant-bootstrap scripts used by the private-installer to reconcile RBAC objects and to create a deterministic audit-event after bootstrap. Scripts are idempotent and have a --dry-run flag for validation.
- Updates CI: helm chart unit tests and policy linting (kubeval, conftest) added to the rbac-policy-bundle pipeline.
- Documentation: doc/tenant-rbac.md with operator runbook, upgrade notes, and recommended least-privilege profiles.

Security notes: Default templates are conservative (least privilege). Admins must explicitly opt into cluster-scoped bindings via values.yaml. All created objects include an annotation `rbac.redwood.com/bootstrapped-by: private-installer` and immutable bootstrap labels to avoid accidental deletion.

Testing performed: unit helm lint, template rendering against representative values (single-tenant / multi-tenant), terraform plan runs in a CI sandbox, and an end-to-end dry-run using the private-installer dev cluster. A flaky e2e run was rerun and passed. See CI section for details.

Upgrade path and rollback: The automation is additive; on upgrade the reconciler will detect existing objects and skip recreation. For rollback, we include a remediation script to remove only objects created by the bootstrap annotation so operator teams can safely revert.

Checklist: [x] Helm templates added and linted. [x] Terraform module with examples. [x] Automation scripts with unit tests. [x] docs and runbook. [x] CI checks added and passing.

Related: Linear ENG-2384 tracks follow-ups for RBAC reconciliation metrics and expanded audit logging. SUP-4432 documents a customer request for automated tenant bootstrap during on-prem installs.

Merge notes: squash-merged to main. Operators should follow the doc/tenant-rbac.md runbook for enabling bootstrap in production; see release notes for values to change.
